imports.source_authority: The import declares the source authority of the records it intakes; a source assertion is an input to House determination, never a substitute.
imports.acceptance_authority: The House authority that determines whether an imported record is accepted; acceptance is never delegated to the source.
imports.reject_conditions: Records that fail structural, semantic, or authority evaluation are rejected and remain non-authoritative.
imports.quarantine_conditions: Records that are ambiguous or unresolved are quarantined pending reconciliation and produce no governed state while held.
imports.partial_success_posture: Partial success is explicit: the outcome names exactly which records were accepted, rejected, or quarantined.
imports.authoritative_state_consequence: An import confers no representative, reviewer, finance, or decision authority; the default consequence for unauthorized content is no governed effect.
